headline: TMO Q2 Deep Dive: Broad-Based End Market Growth and Strategic Portfolio Moves
summary: Life sciences company Thermo Fisher (NYSE:TMO) reported Q2 CY2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 10.5% year on year to $11.99 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $6.03 per share was 5.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

headline: Thermo Fisher (TMO) Lands ImmuPharma Kapiglucagon Diabetes Manufacturing Role
summary: Thermo Fisher Scientific (NYSE:TMO) has been selected by ImmuPharma as the key drug product and contract development manufacturer for its Kapiglucagon diabetes treatment program. The partnership covers development and manufacturing support for Kapiglucagon, an experimental therapy aimed at addressing diabetes.
